result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, matching the other per-rep reports.

- **Fix** in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`: the subquery gets `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarterly purchase-order query uses. I also updated its Javadoc to say cancelled orders are not counted.
- **Test** in `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`: added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`, which reproduces your example (Anna 2, Bob 1). The test helper gained an overload that takes a status; the existing calls still use `SENT`.

`mvn -o test -Dtest=SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests, 0 failures). I did not run the full suite and did not commit.
